lastCompletedStory.title: Reserve keybar rows; derive StoriesSection window from pane height

openQuestions: computeStoriesLayout uses a conservative-but-live per-render reservation (exact SummaryPanel/RecentSection heights mirrored from `data`, not a hardcoded worst-case constant) rather than the literal 'reserve Summary at its MAX height' wording in the story notes: using the literal max broke the existing multi-row-visibility assertions (test1519 et al.) at the suite's default rows=24 mock, since Summary-max(10)+Recent-max(8)+Keybar(10) alone already exceeds 24. The live-mirror approach is exact per render (never stale) and keeps every pinned test green; flag at review if a stricter worst-case reservation is still desired for the rare same-render combo of (populated story list + tokens/cost rows both appearing + a very short pane), which no current test exercises.
nextStoryContext: STORIES_WINDOW=8 is gone from Dashboard.tsx; the Stories panel window size + chrome-vs-compact presentation is now derived per render via computeStoriesLayout(rows, data) (reserves summaryPanelHeight(data) + recentSectionHeight(recent) + KEYBAR_HEIGHT, then either shows the Section with chrome + a rows-derived window, or (when budget is too tight for chrome + 1 row) drops the Section heading/divider/gap and renders bare rows). Keybar/DetailKeybar remain unwindowed and unchanged. If a future story adds another fixed section to the list-mode composition (between SummaryPanel and Keybar), it must also be folded into computeStoriesLayout's reservedOther sum or it will silently eat into the Stories budget and risk clipping the keybar again.

officialDocsValidated.summary: useWindowSize() return shape ({columns, rows}) and resize-driven re-render confirmed matching current usage. Ink's docs describe Box's default overflowY as 'visible', but this story's own empirical ink-testing-library renders confirm the root Box passed to render() with a fixed height prop hard-clips/pads to exactly that many lines regardless (the pre-existing CAM-345 mechanism, not something this story changed) -- recorded as a patterns.md bullet since the docs wording alone is ambiguous/incomplete on this point.
